notes: «- يعني ابن عمر بن غانم -» and «- يعني ابن زياد -» are glosses in dashes and are left out.
«أن عمة، له حدثته أنها، سألت عائشة» : the aunt is the asker (a link, named only by relation: relation), and Aisha, who answers, is the last link.
«عبد الله» occurs twice; the second is the standalone name written before the gloss.
